notes.title: Minor Subtitle Update
notes.notes: This update is mostly just to fix some typos in the German subtitles.

notes.title: I hope this update gets a Brazilian new players!
notes.notes:
Big thanks to Kauã, Combine (Bob), and Cold for translating the subtitles and menus!  I wasn't planning to attempt to localize this game because it has so many puns, but they gave it a great shot!

Here's what's new in this build:
[olist]
 Localization support for Portuguese (Brazil)
 Localization support for French
 Added icons to Play, Resume, Settings, Restart, and Quit buttons to help people navigate if they don't understand English.
 Created a settings submenu to reduce clutter on the main menu, now that there are language options.
 Fixed menu background sound getting stuck on (hopefully for real this time).
 Fixed paint buckets collected count displaying the incorrect number if you complete the game multiple times.
 Fixed closing the console causing the game to unpause while a menu was open.
[/olist]

notes.title: Can you expect more bad puns with this update?
notes.notes:
Fixed some bugs, added some landmarks to help reduce confusion, and added more bad jokes to help increase confusion.


 Added an end screen with a summary of time taken and paint cans collected.
 Smoke and soda can landmarks to help people figure out where they are after falling down.
 In addition to "camera goop", "camera loop", and "camera average", there's a "camera freeze" console command, on the off chance people want to make videos or some nonsense where the goop rolls into frame.
 More useless console commands to troll people trying to type in cheats.
 Attempted to ensure the menu background sound doesn't play once the game is running.
 Timer doesn't start until intro cinematic finishes.
